itemDecision.rationale: K2 assesses the learning goal 'Mittlere resultierende Kraft aus der Impulsänderung bestimmen': determining signed momentum change, applying mean net external force = Δp/Δt and interpreting force direction. Its complete 3+4+3-point rubric assesses linear mechanics. The explicit local LI_KRAEFTE→LI_BEWEGUNG normalization and released force assessments support exactly LI_BEWEGUNG. Applying that convention to this interval-force task is an inference.
actualTaskAndRubricEvidence: For a fixed-mass cart in an inertial laboratory frame, the task supplies p1 = +8 kg·m/s at 2 s and p2 = −4 kg·m/s at 5 s. The reference solution obtains Δp = −12 kg·m/s, Δt = 3 s and mean net external force −4 N, directed left for right-positive coordinates.

momentumChange carries 3 points for the applied signed numerical change. An uncontradicted general change formula alone receives only 0.5; a final force does not retrospectively establish missing momentum-change evidence.

meanForce carries 4 points: 3 for applying Δp/Δt with the elapsed 3 s, 0.5 for the force value or valid own calculation and 0.5 for the force unit. These points directly assess the mechanical force–momentum relation.

direction carries 3 points: 0.5 for the force sign and 2.5 for its physical directional interpretation. The solution and rubric distinguish an interval average from an unsupported assertion of constant or particular instantaneous force; the latter costs 2.5 once in meanForce.

Recursive comparison found exactly one predecessor-to-successor difference: examData.coveredStrands, [] → ["LI_BEWEGUNG"]. Every other field is identical. Both language versions of task and solution, the full scoring object and the 8/10 passing threshold are also identical across original, predecessor and successor. K2 remains V3.
taxonomyEvidence: The supplied validateGraph.ts excerpt permits LI_BEWEGUNG but supplies no substantive strand definition.

The supplied normalization explicitly maps LI_KRAEFTE to LI_BEWEGUNG in coveredStrands and guidingIdeas. This directly supports including assessed mechanical forces within the local normalized strand.

Released circular-motion assessment b1808b4c-5e02-5e1f-831f-47ee126e00ee has solely LI_BEWEGUNG: 5/16 points assess velocity/acceleration vectors, 5/16 centripetal acceleration and force, and 6/16 limiting speed and force dependencies. It demonstrates actual classification of quantitative dynamics under this strand.

Released force-vector assessment 8f62ab5e-20fc-562f-8121-63c082313e6e uses solely LI_BEWEGUNG for directed forces, resultant construction and equilibrium, supporting K2's force-direction classification.

The released horizontal-projection assessment also uses solely LI_BEWEGUNG for motion vectors and a scored no-horizontal-force explanation. Together these examples support the local dynamics classification; none explicitly defines the strand or maps Δp/Δt by name.
itemDecision.otherStrandsExcludedReason: Every scored component concerns momentum change, elapsed time, resultant force or force direction. No criterion assesses energy transfer, work, fields, waves, material properties, technological design or cosmology. The cart and laboratory context do not independently assess technology or energy.
limitations: The force normalization and released examples support a local classification inference, not a fabricated official definition of LI_BEWEGUNG.
The sole covered learning goal remains ecbaa101-cb10-5da3-9368-ae40ff587d74. Prerequisite momentum knowledge does not add another covered goal.

taxonomyEvidenceLimit: Local allowed native taxon ID, explicit mechanical-force→movement normalization and actual released mechanics examples support classification; no official prose definition is invented. The independent item rationale states its inference.
